items.summary: arXiv:2610.21491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tokenized equities trade while listed markets are closed, so their marks could improve off-hours measurement along layered exposures that link Bitcoin, crypto-treasury stocks, and leveraged ETFs. A token return and the next opening gap, however, share the price move from the previous close to the token mark, so part of their apparent fit is mechanical. items.title: Feeling the generalised rough SABR boundary

source.name: Masaaki Fukasawa, Antoine Jacquier, Mugad Oumgari

items.summary: arXiv:2610.21841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We provide an in-depth analysis of a generalised rough version of the SABR volatility model, widely used in the financial industry. We specifically focus on its behaviour at the origin, whether it can reach it and how fast it may do so.
